episode_summary: In this episode, Bella Chaffey Lakic shares her journey from a young real estate agent with no sphere of influence to becoming an NAR 30 under 30 honoree. She discusses the power of YouTube as a marketing tool, the importance of creating evergreen content, and how agents can stand out by focusing on valuable, localized video content. Bella also emphasizes the significance of community involvement and industry service in building a successful real estate career.
